product_overview: School admins can compose and send notifications to parents, classrooms, or buses; the system persists notifications and delivers push messages via FCM, and guardians receive alerts (including when a student boards a bus).
core_goals: Allow school administrators to create, preview, and send notifications to targeted recipient groups (all parents, by classroom, by bus, or specific parent).
Notify guardians in near-real-time when their child boards or alights a bus and record boarding/alighting events.
Persist all notifications in the database so they are viewable even if push delivery (FCM) fails.
Provide recipient count preview before sending so admins can confirm targets.
Handle missing FCM tokens or FCM failures gracefully (log errors and keep notifications stored).

features.name: School Notification Sending
features.description: School admins compose notifications (title + message), select recipient type and filters, preview recipient count, and send the notification; backend persists the notification and attempts FCM push delivery.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email field -> Fill password field -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /school/notifications/create -> Fill notification title -> Fill notification message -> Select recipient type (All Parents) -> Click Preview to see recipient count -> See recipient count displayed -> Click Send Notification button -> POST /school/notifications returns 200 -> See success confirmation message -> Recipients receive push notification (if FCM tokens present)

Navigate to /school/notifications/create -> Fill notification message -> Select recipient type (By Classroom) -> Click Preview to see recipient count -> See validation error 'Title is required' displayed -> Fill notification title -> Click Preview to see recipient count -> See recipient count displayed -> Click Send Notification button -> POST /school/notifications returns 200 -> See success confirmation message

Navigate to /school/notifications/create -> Fill notification title -> Fill notification message -> Select recipient type (By Bus) -> Select specific filters (Buses) -> Click Preview to see recipient count -> See recipient count displayed -> Click Send Notification button -> POST /school/notifications returns 200 -> Background job attempts FCM delivery -> See system log entry indicating no FCM tokens found for some recipients -> See notification recorded in notifications table but no push delivered to those recipients

features.name: Guardian Notification for Student Boarding
features.description: When a driver or supervisor records a student boarding via the mobile API, the system saves a BusBoardingLog and triggers a 'student_boarded' notification to the student's guardian(s) via NotificationService (FCM + persisted notification).
user_flows: POST /api/auth/login with driver credentials -> Receive authentication token -> POST /api/bus/{id}/board with student identifier and token -> Server saves BusBoardingLog -> NotificationService sends FCM to student's guardian(s) -> Guardian receives push notification on mobile -> Guardian opens app -> Navigate to /notifications -> See new 'student_boarded' notification -> Tap notification -> See notification details
POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive authentication error response -> See login failure message and stop (driver cannot record boarding)

POST /api/auth/login with driver credentials -> Receive authentication token -> POST /api/bus/{id}/board with student identifier and token -> Server saves BusBoardingLog -> NotificationService attempts FCM delivery -> No FCM token exists for guardian -> System logs FCM failure and marks push as not delivered -> Guardian does not receive push -> Guardian later opens app -> Navigate to /notifications -> See persisted 'student_boarded' notification
